purpose: Bulk planetary data for L01 figures: ss-mass-budget, density-vs-distance, mass-vs-distance, vem-atmospheres, planet-sizes (and reused by other lectures).

columns.mass_earth_units: Planet mass in Earth masses (M_Earth = 5.9722e24 kg).
columns.radius_km: Volumetric mean radius in km. For giants, this is the 1-bar radius equivalent.
columns.semi_major_axis_AU: Orbital semi-major axis in astronomical units.
columns.sidereal_rotation_h: Sidereal rotation period in hours; negative values indicate retrograde rotation.
columns.Tsurf_K: Mean surface temperature (K). For giants, this is the temperature at the 1-bar reference level.
columns.Psurf_bar: Surface pressure (bar). 0 for Mercury (effectively no atmosphere). Giants do not have a solid surface; the value 1 bar refers to the reference level.
columns.dominant_species: Most abundant atmospheric constituent by volume.

license_note: NASA Planetary Fact Sheet content is public domain.
uncertainties_note: Surface temperatures for terrestrial bodies are global means; for Mars in particular, diurnal and seasonal variability is large.
